name: Sequence
description: Represents a collection of Effect objects for a slide's interactive animation sequences. The Sequence collection is a member of the Sequences collection.
example:
Sub NewEffect()

    Dim effNew As Effect
    Dim shpFirst As Shape

    Set shpFirst = ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(1)

    Set effNew = ActivePresentation.Slides(1).TimeLine.MainSequence.AddEffect _
        (Shape:=shpFirst, effectId:=msoAnimEffectBlinds)

End Sub

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Effect object from the specified Sequence collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Effect object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: AddEffect
methods.signature: AddEffect(Shape As Shape, effectId As MsoAnimEffect, [Level As MsoAnimateByLevel], [trigger As MsoAnimTriggerType], [Index As Long]) As Effect
methods.description: Returns an Effect object that represents a new animation effect added to a sequence of animation effects.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: The shape to which the animation effect is added.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The animation effect to be applied.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: For charts, diagrams, or text, the level to which the animation effect will be applied. The default value is msoAnimationLevelNone.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The action that triggers the animation effect. The default value is msoAnimTriggerOnPageClick.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The position at which the effect will be placed in the collection of animation effects. The default value is -1 (added to the end).

methods.name: Clone
methods.signature: Clone(Effect As Effect, [Index As Long]) As Effect
methods.description: Creates a copy of an Effect object, and adds it to the Sequences collection at the specified index position.

parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: Effect object. The animation effect to be cloned.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The position at which the cloned animation effect will be added to the Sequences collection. The default value is -1 (added to the end).

methods.name: FindFirstAnimationFor
methods.description: Returns an Effect object that represents the first animation for a given shape.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: The shape for which to find the first animation.

methods.name: FindFirstAnimationForClick
methods.description: Returns an Effect object that represents the first animation started by the specified click number.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: The specified click number.

methods.name: ConvertToBuildLevel
methods.signature: ConvertToBuildLevel(Effect As Effect, Level As MsoAnimateByLevel) As Effect
methods.description: Changes the build level information for a specified animation effect. Returns an Effect object that represents the build level information.

parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: The specified animation effect.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The animation build level.

methods.name: ConvertToAfterEffect
methods.signature: ConvertToAfterEffect(Effect As Effect, After As MsoAnimAfterEffect, [DimColor As MsoRGBType], [DimSchemeColor As PpColorSchemeIndex]) As Effect
methods.description: Specifies what an effect should do after it is finished. Returns an Effect object that represents an after effect.

parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: The effect to which the after effect will be added.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The behavior of the after effect.

parameters.name: DimColor
parameters.description: A single color to apply the after effect.

parameters.name: DimSchemeColor
parameters.description: A predefined color scheme to apply to the after effect.

methods.name: ConvertToAnimateBackground
methods.signature: ConvertToAnimateBackground(Effect As Effect, AnimateBackground As MsoTriState) As Effect
methods.description: Determines whether the background will be animated separately from, or in addition to, its accompanying text. Returns an Effect object representing the newly-modified animation effect.

parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: The animation effect to be applied to the background.

parameters.name: AnimateBackground
parameters.description: Determines whether the text will be animated separately from the background.

methods.name: ConvertToAnimateInReverse
methods.signature: ConvertToAnimateInReverse(Effect As Effect, animateInReverse As MsoTriState) As Effect
methods.description: Determines whether text will be animated in reverse order. Returns an Effect object representing the text animation.

parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: The animation effect to which the reversal will apply.

parameters.name: animateInReverse
parameters.description: Determines the text animation order.

methods.name: ConvertToTextUnitEffect
methods.signature: ConvertToTextUnitEffect(Effect As Effect, unitEffect As MsoAnimTextUnitEffect) As Effect
methods.description: Returns an Effect object that represents how text should be animated.

parameters.name: Effect
parameters.description: The animation effect to which the text unit effect applies.

parameters.name: unitEffect
parameters.description: How the text should be animated.

methods.name: AddTriggerEffect
methods.signature: AddTriggerEffect(pShape As Shape, effectId As MsoAnimEffect, trigger As MsoAnimTriggerType, pTriggerShape As Shape, [bookmark As String], [Level As MsoAnimateByLevel]) As Effect
methods.description: Adds a trigger effect to the animation in a Sequence object.

parameters.name: pShape
parameters.description: The Shape object with animation.

parameters.name: effectId
parameters.description: The type of animation.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The type of trigger effect to add.

parameters.name: pTriggerShape
parameters.description: The Shape object that represents the trigger.

parameters.name: bookmark
parameters.description: The bookmark.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The level of animation.
